messages.author: dbc3325e3846f67d
messages.subject: working directory
parts:
Dear all,

I know that in Windows if you open a R script with Notepad++ and send
the script to R console, the default working directory is the
directory where the script file is located.

I'm wondering if there's any way to get the directory/path of the
current R script? What I want is basically an OS-independent way of
setting the working directory of the script to be the directory where
the R script is put. Something like:

setwd(GetThePathOfTheCurrentScript());

Thanks in advance!

Alvin Chen
